classical_inputs.algebraic_gap: Bourgain-Gamburd SU(d) or Benoist-de Saxce Theorem 1.2; Peter-Weyl transfer and lazy actual-command measure.
classical_inputs.entropy_converse: Inherited v62 finite budget, not a new universal entropy inequality.
classical_inputs.finite_arithmetic: Standard matrix propagation, trace-preserving entry approximation with diagonal repair, binary long division and rejection sampling.
classical_inputs.trace_norm: Watrous Corollary 3.40; direct Jordan proof supplied.

new_claims.channels: Deterministic legal density-matrix approximation with the same space upper bound, exact O(N) fallback.
new_claims.cutpoint_comparison: Versioned Chen-Wu comparison and an elementary attenuation proposition; no claim of new general stochasticization.
new_claims.exact_rational_emissions: Integer interval rejection with fresh fair bits, almost-sure termination, worst-case bounded storage and explicit expected bit/time bounds.
new_claims.explicit_every_fixed_dimension: Adjacent-coordinate rational SU(d) alphabet; imported algebraic spectral gap, not an effective dimension-uniform gap constant.
new_claims.higher_dimensional_sharp_space: Written entropy/configuration lower and positive-arithmetic upper; full-action gap and all-direction cap hypotheses; constants/data fixed independently of N,L.
new_claims.instrument_sharpness: Restriction to expanding unitary subsystem; lower bound requires the numerical matrix interface, not transcript-only approximation.
new_claims.positive_rounding: Written proof of R_B=(BQ_B+2dI)/(B+2d^2), legal fixed-denominator matrices, trace error <=6d^2/B, integer implementation.
new_claims.rational_instruments: Written one-pass finite-bit construction for fixed Gaussian-rational Kraus data; adaptive classical controls; summed subnormalized trace error <=2^-L; no outcome floor or spectral premise.

proof_vs_execution: Complete written proofs are arguments. Exact finite regression, source hashes and PDF reconstruction do not certify universal proof, independent novelty or journal acceptance.
